thread:
jamal: Heads-up — multiple customers (acct-prod) reporting p99 spikes ~4-6s on /v1/generate in us-west since 09:10 PDT. Support attached short logs. Paging since this is hitting SLAs.

oncall-bot: ALERT: Spike detected for model-redwood-3b-us-west. metrics: p99=6.2s, p95=1.1s, error_rate=0.12%. Incident INC-1768509999 created.

sophia: assigning to oncall. can we get a quick breakdown by model/version + region? any recent deploys? @alejandro

alejandro: no deploys in last 6h. quick glance at routing: heavy headroom pressure on x-gpu-pool-12, looks like queuing/long tail. quick mitigations i suggest: 1) shift %, 2) reduce pool concurrency, 3) enable quant fallback for bursty traffic. i'll run the cmds unless objections.

alejandro: ```
# shift 30% traffic to pool-08
cli-rw route update --service gen-api --region us-west --split 'pool-12:70,pool-08:30'
# lower concurrency on pool-12
cli-rw pool update pool-12 --max-concurrency 32
# enable model fallback to quant variant on cheaper nodes
cli-rw model fallback enable --model model-redwood-3b --variant quant --region us-west
```

zoe: support confirms no billing/token anomaly — qps spike traced to a customer integration loop. prompts are slightly longer than usual but not monstrous.

sophia: also want a rapid circuit-breaker so one api-key can't back up the whole pool. propose per-api-key rate limit 60rpm burst 300 + cb at p99 5000ms. applying routing guardrails now.

sophia: ```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "rate_limit": {"per_api_key": 60, "burst": 300},
  "circuit_breaker": {"p99_threshold_ms": 5000, "window_sec": 60}
}
```

alejandro: applied route split to pool-08 and reduced pool-12 concurrency; fallback to quant variant enabled. monitoring stream open.

oncall-bot: METRIC UPDATE (09:22): p99=2.1s, p95=0.9s, error_rate=0.08%. Trend: improving after traffic shift and cb.

jamal: thanks team. i've told support to notify affected customers we're mitigating and will follow up in 30m. if p99 > 3s we re-open and escalate to eng-sre.

zoe: :thumbsup:
